situation: A guy from another department asked me to dinner. He's nice but I'm not interested, and we'll keep running into each other at the coffee machine.
reply: That's really kind of you, and I'm flattered you asked. I don't see us that way, though, so I'll say no. I hope it doesn't make the coffee machine weird.
note: A clear no plus a light nod to the shared space lets you both carry on normally at work.

situation: 相亲认识的男生，见了三次面，人挺好，但我没感觉。他约我周末去看展。
reply: 谢谢你这几次的安排，和你聊天很舒服。我认真想了想，对我们之间没有那种感觉，不想拖着让你误会，所以周末就不去了。真心祝你一切顺利。
note: 不给理由清单，不说“以后再说”，含糊才是最伤人的。

situation: Après deux rendez-vous avec un gars rencontré sur une appli, je lui ai dit que je ne voulais pas continuer. Il m'envoie des messages pour avoir une autre chance.
reply: Je t'ai bien entendu, et je ne vais pas changer d'avis. Je vais arrêter de répondre maintenant, et je te souhaite le meilleur.
note: One calm closing line, then no more replies. If he turns hostile, block.

situation: My friend Theo from our Thursday climbing group texted last night that he has feelings for me. I don't feel the same, but I really like him as a friend and want to keep climbing together.
reply: Theo, thank you for telling me, I know that took guts. I don't feel the same way, and I'd rather be straight with you than leave it hanging. I really value you as a friend and I'd love to keep climbing on Thursdays, but if you want to skip a few weeks first, that's completely fine.
note: Friendship is offered only because she genuinely wants it, and the space line lets him step back without it meaning anything.

situation: Been seeing Marcus for about 10 weeks. He's lovely but I'm just not feeling it. We have dinner booked Thursday and I don't want to do it there, so I'm calling him tonight. What do I actually say?
reply: Marcus, I want to be straight with you, because you deserve that. I've realised I'm not in this the way I'd want to be, and it isn't fair to either of us for me to keep going, so I don't think we should do dinner on Thursday. You've been really kind to me these last couple of months. I'm sorry.
note: After a couple of months, a call rather than a text, and before the booked dinner so he isn't told over a table he can't leave. If he asks why, it's fit, not a list.

situation: Matched with Sam on Hinge, we've been texting for five days and he just asked to meet for a drink Saturday. I've realised I'm not into it and we've never actually met.
reply: Hey Sam, thanks for asking, and I've enjoyed hearing about your sourdough disasters. I'm going to pass on meeting up though, I'm not feeling the spark I'd want before a first date. Good luck with the next loaf.
note: Before a first meeting, a short kind no beats ghosting; no reason needed beyond fit.
